scenario.summary: This article outlines common attacker behaviors observed across endpoint and identity planes, including credential stuffing against VPNs, the use of encoded PowerShell for execution, and persistence via unauthorized RMM tools like ScreenConnect. The intrusion culminates in credential theft via LSASS dumping and the destruction of system recovery options like volume shadow copies to maximize impact.

meta.rationale: Focus on workstations and servers with internet-facing RMM software; prioritize accounts with local or domain administrator privileges.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has gained a foothold using unauthorized remote management software or encoded scripts and is now attempting to dump credentials and inhibit system recovery.

hunt.name: Endpoint Intrusion and Impact Chain
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the transition from a suspicious endpoint foothold to high-impact post-exploitation. It first identifies systems running unauthorized remote management (RMM) tools or experiencing rare account creations. It then pivots to look for follow-on actions like LSASS memory access and volume shadow copy deletion on those same systems. By correlating early-stage persistence with late-stage impact tradecraft, an analyst can distinguish an active intrusion from routine maintenance.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, vendor_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (instr(',' || '{{rmm_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(vendor_name) || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify hosts that have remote management tools installed, which can serve as unauthorized persistence mechanisms.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and the specific RMM software found. This narrows the hunt to systems with external access capabilities.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, script_content, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_script_activity WHERE (LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%virtualalloc%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%marshal%' OR LOWER(script_content) LIKE '%reflectiveload%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find script blocks containing keywords associated with memory manipulation or reflective loading.
config.expected_signal: Scripts that attempt to execute code in memory, often bypassing command-line detection.

primitive_config.label: Suspicious PowerShell script blocks

config.content: SELECT user_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_name HAVING host_count <= 2
config.description: Stack-count account creation events across the fleet to find accounts created on only a few hosts.
config.expected_signal: New accounts that appear on only 1 or 2 systems, highlighting potential unauthorized persistence.

primitive_config.label: Rare account creations
primitive_config.content: SELECT user_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_account_change WHERE activity_id = 1 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_name HAVING host_count <= 2

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_process_name, object_name, access_mask, time FROM hb_resource_activity WHERE object_type = 'Process' AND (LOWER(object_name) LIKE '%\\lsass.exe') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%vssadmin%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%delete%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%shadow%') OR (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%wmic%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%shadowcopy%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%delete%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

config.description: Verify the automated findings and determine the scope of the compromise.
